# Rebecca Node 1.5.0

Rebecca Node 1.5.0 improves the lifecycle of native proxy runtimes and keeps node operations aligned with Rebecca 1.5.0.

## Highlights

- 🔄 **Native-runtime reconciliation** — check and recover managed Tor, Windscribe, and other native services when the node starts or receives updated configuration.
- 🛡️ **Conflict prevention** — reject occupied managed-proxy ports and incompatible duplicate Windscribe relays before applying changes.
- 🧰 **Actionable runtime errors** — report service setup and health failures to the master for per-node diagnosis.
- ⚙️ **Stable maintenance** — preserve exact Dev-build selection and avoid unnecessary restarts of healthy Tor proxies.

## Reliability and compatibility

- The master selects Xray-version-specific configuration; the node continues to run the configured official Xray binary without a patched core.
- Existing node identity, certificates, custom service names, and managed runtime settings are retained on upgrade.
- Runtime reconciliation repairs missing services while avoiding unnecessary disruption to healthy processes.

## Upgrade notes

> Upgrade Rebecca and Rebecca Node together. If a master configuration uses new Xray 26.9.9 fields, install a compatible official Xray core on the target node. Older cores remain supported through version-aware master output.
